title: The Saxophone Theory of Everything
text:
The “Smartphone Theory of Everything” — the idea that smartphones are wholly or partially to blame for a wide range of negative social trends — has gained traction in recent years. 
Something similar happened with radio — and a new genre it helped popularize: Jazz. Giving rise to what you could call ‘The Saxophone Theory of Everything.’
Here are some headlines that blamed jazz for negative macro trends:
